prompt: /simplify 这个借款确认页太乱了，帮我精简一下
expectedBehaviors: Runs the product-correctness check before any visual stripping (e.g. CTA disabled in empty state)
Applies the 5-question evaluation framework to each element
Strips decorative elements and boilerplate copy while preserving compliance-critical content
Keeps a single primary CTA and one primary number

prompt: 清理一下我刚生成的那个微粒贷首页，文案能短则短，去掉装饰
expectedBehaviors: Shortens copy to <=15 characters where possible
Removes background dot patterns, triangle decorations, and emoji
Merges redundant elements (e.g. label + value into one line)

prompt: 这个 Figma 链接 https://figma.com/design/xyz 的页面太花哨了，按 WLD 规范精简，元素太多了
expectedBehaviors: Distills the existing Figma design down to essentials
Removes clutter and competing focal points
Preserves what the user truly needs to see and do

prompt: This WLD screen feels way too cluttered and busy — clean it up and distill it to the essentials
expectedBehaviors: Identifies decorative vs functional elements and removes decoration
Reduces text and visual noise without losing required product content
Leaves a single clear primary action
